title: Resolve current editorial context through one publication-scoped CLI and library
description: Feature: Current editorial context. Scenario: Fetch a scoped policy. Given a configured publication and current mission and policy records, when an agent resolves publication plus optional section/story/assignment context, then one rendered text and source revisions identify that scope. Scenario: Explicit offline configuration. Given local Git configuration, when local context is requested, then source provenance says local and never claims to be current hosted policy. Scenario: Missing or unauthorized policy. Given missing required doctrine, ambiguous revisions or an unauthorized read, when context is fetched, then execution fails explicitly without seed fallback. Scenario: Required policy budget. Given a budget smaller than required policy, when context is requested, then it fails instead of truncating required policy.
